summary.text: Amy Martinez-Salas is the Democratic candidate for the Texas State Senate, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election and in a special general election for the same district held the same day, facing Republican David Cook.
She works as a legal assistant.

paragraphs.text: Amy Martinez-Salas graduated from Arlington High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Arlington in 2024.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a mother of four and the first in her family to graduate from high school and hold a bachelor's degree, and that she is pursuing a master's degree in multidisciplinary studies with a focus on rural health.
She said she spent years working in healthcare and was two classes short of a nursing degree before moving into legal work.
Martinez-Salas advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for District 22.
In her survey, she listed water infrastructure for the district's rural counties and rural healthcare, including keeping local hospitals open, among her key messages.
